text:
elaine: Heads-up — found a subtle migration bug with v1->v2 invoke params. If request body includes top-level 'model' param + v2 also reads model_id, some shims are silently mapping wrong. Repro steps below.

mike: ouch. can you paste repro?

elaine: steps:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/invoke -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"..."}'
2) v2 shim converts to model_id='redwood-13b' but alias map resolves to gpu-slim-13b, fallback to 'redwood-7b' when capacity constrained

ryan: that's scary — leads to silent quality regression

elaine: yes. file we should add to docs: migration guide section 'param collisions & silent fallbacks'. Also add lint that flags 'model' in body for v2-targeted snippets.

doc-bot: Reminder: open PR template /docs/migration/param-collisions.md suggested.

kevin: I'll spin a docs PR. quick question: do we want to change runtime to reject 'model' in body or just warn?

mike: prefer warn+opt-in strict mode. enterprise might rely on fallback behavior.

elaine: agree. Docs should 1) show example with explicit model_id, 2) show how to opt into strict param checking via header X-Redwood-Strict: true, 3) include CLI snippet to run smoke test.

kevin: PR branch: docs/param-clash-warning  — I'll include snippet and a small linter rule in docs CI.

kevin: snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model_id":"redwood-13b","input":"Summarize..."}'
```

ryan: add a short note about alias maps and model variants (gpu/quant) — how alias resolution can change perf/quality.

elaine: yes, and add a migration checklist item: run `scripts/check-model-aliases.sh` before swapping.

mike: can we also patch legacy docs that still show `model:` in examples? There are a few in /docs/examples/* that the search index missed.

kevin: I'm running a grep, will open PRs for any hits. ETA EOD.

elaine: thx. Also notify SDKs — JS/TS/py may have helper that serializes body with 'model'. @ryan can you ping sdk leads?

ryan: pinged @sdk-js, @sdk-py — they said they'll land a minor client-side change to map model->model_id and emit console.warn.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled for docs PRs at 2026-03-23T02:00Z :rocket:

kevin: created PR 4821, draft. Anyone wanna review? small unit tests included.

mike: ack, reviewing now.

elaine: once merged, let's add a short note in the deprecation notice page and a redirect from old examples.

kevin: will add redirect entries to /redirects/v1-model-param.json

mike: tiny nit — example curl should use --data-binary to avoid shell expansion on Windows. I'll add alternative snippet.

elaine: perfect. closing loop: if no major objections I'll mark this resolved and add to next week's docs sync. :white_check_mark:

ryan: LGTM.
